project_overview.theme: Dark Theme (Premium, Sexy, Feminine, Elegant, Modern)
project_overview.vibe: Luxury, exclusivity, mystery, desire, confidence. Professional and sophisticated, no spam look.

typography.strategy: Editorial Future (Wide Display Sans + Geometric Body) mixed with Luxury (Classic Serif Headings).

headings.font_family: Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond (Serif) for emotional/sensual impact.
headings.styles: Elegant, tracking-tight, light or medium weights.

accents.font_family: JetBrains Mono or similar for badges and micro-copy (adds a modern, premium digital feel).

rules: No generic gradients; rely on noise, grain, and soft ambient glows.
Use #0A0508 (Tinted Dark Rose/Black) instead of pure black.
Use gold sparingly for VIP badges and premium highlights.
Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for normal text.

layouts.strategy: Mobile-first, high density but with breathing room. The Bento Grid Protocol for Dashboard.
layouts.spacing: Generous on desktop (p-12 to p-24), tight and focused on mobile (p-4 to p-8).

sections.hero: Full height (min-h-[80vh]), background image with dark bordeaux overlay (bg-black/60). Center aligned or bottom aligned text for dramatic effect.
sections.social_proof: Horizontal scrolling cards on mobile. Professional dashboard-like summary (4.9/5 stars, progress bars).
sections.chat_carousel: Swipable carousel showing chat prints. Subtle blur or mask on edges.
sections.pricing: 3 columns on desktop, stacked on mobile. Middle '7 days' card highlighted with glowing border (The Tracing Beam effect).
sections.admin_dashboard: Sidebar navigation (hidden behind hamburger on mobile), dense bento grids for analytics, glassmorphism for sticky headers.

surfaces: Glassmorphism (Crystal): For sticky nav, floating WhatsApp button, and live notifications. bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10.
Neumorphism (Tactile): For pricing cards and testimonial cards. Solid #1A0B12 with subtle 1px border-rosa_queimado/20.
The Tracing Beam: For the VIP/Most Popular pricing card to signal 'Active/Premium'.
textures: Subtle film grain overlay to kill digital flatness and enhance the 'boudoir editorial' feel.
borders: 1px solid border-white/5 to border-white/10 for cards and containers.

interactions: Hover on buttons: slight lift (-translate-y-1), increased shadow and glow (shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,42,112,0.5)]).
Carousel swipe: smooth momentum (Lenis smooth scroll if possible).
entrances: Live activity notifications (bottom corner): slide up, hold 3s, fade out.

components_and_libraries.ui_library: shadcn/ui (customized heavily for the luxury dark theme).
components_and_libraries.icons: lucide-react or @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone weight for premium feel).
components_and_libraries.animations: framer-motion for entrances and the tracing beam effect.
components_and_libraries.toasts: sonner (used for the discreet live activity notifications in the bottom corner).

hero.description: Elegant silhouette of a woman with wine, setting a mysterious and luxurious tone.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
DO NOT apply universal transitions like `transition: all`. Use specific transitions.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive and key informational elements.
NEVER use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on headers or overlays; use bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur.
Build the dashboard using a standard sidebar layout with dark theme variations of Shadcn components.
Add subtle grain textures and noise overlays to background elements.
Use Lucide icons for UI elements.
Prioritize HTML semantics and accessibility (WCAG AA).
Share guidelines for .js files, not .tsx files.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against dark backgrounds passes APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.focus: Use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rosa_queimado on inputs and buttons.
